scope: In-process Windows GPUI and loopback worker regressions
input: GPUI test window clicks on ordinary controls

cases.observed: Two views shared one durable comment draft and one editor. A submit and a focus change to another item occurred in the same frame while a SQLite writer held the queue. The repeated submit left one operation on the original item, repository and draft revision.
The review used one original draft and retained both source anchors and the original head. Focusing an unrelated item before queue commit and clicking submit again left a single staged review.
Confirm Merge pinning the original PR, revision and method survived the same focus change and repeated click. The Outbox added one merge and the unrelated pane stayed focused.

Three generation changes interrupted a held authenticated GET. One replacement reached the server at or after its persisted retry floor. A later explicit check returned 401 and ordinary wakes made no further request.

portable_interrupted_probe.scope: Isolated Linux x64 worker comparison with synthetic account credentials and a held localhost /user response

before.outcome: Fail. The initial regression timed out waiting for Reachable after the request was interrupted.

with_correction.outcome: Pass. The strengthened fixture recorded one replacement at the persisted retry deadline and no repeated request after 401.
